name: 网页取证
description: 左侧浏览器 + 右侧步骤栏：打开页面、逐步取证点击/输入，一键发送报告附件到对话；AI 通过 6 个 web_capture_* 工具读取存档。
descriptionEn: Browser left + steps sidebar right: open pages, capture clicks/inputs step by step, one click sends a report attachment to chat; AI reads and saves via 6 web_capture_* tools.

settings.label: 步骤栏默认宽度

settings.hintEn: Right steps sidebar width in px; draggable inside the tab, remembered per browser

settings.label: 遮罩密码框
settings.hint: 录制输入步骤时，密码框只记“已输入”不记具体值
settings.hintEn: When recording input steps, password fields are logged as typed without values

settings.label: 访问后自动快照
settings.hint: 打开同源页面后自动抓取一次元素快照
settings.hintEn: Automatically capture an element snapshot after opening a same-origin page

settings.label: 最多保留步数
settings.hint: 超出后丢弃最早的步骤
settings.hintEn: Oldest steps are dropped past this limit
